family: R9-N neutral: capital scale-up tren majority_1x frozen (tiep noi N-volcap v32; tra loi 'bot von lon co sao khong')
hypothesis: o quy mo indexed-100, v32 chung minh mien nhiem (k=5% van 0 bar bi chan, qty nho hon cap 3-4 bac). Vi engine compounding theo von (notional=equity*1x, qty=notional/cand tang theo equity), khi von khoi diem tang len 10k/1M thi qty co the vuot cap=k*bar_volume va volcap bat dau can (delay trong expiry 12-bar hoac mat fill). Thi nghiem do nguong von noi volcap bat dau can, KHONG phai gate loi nhuan.
volume_unit: base BTC per 5m bar (quote_volume chi de tham chieu; taker_buy_volume ton tai nhung khong dung)
branch_count_note: 7 branches (1 control + 3 von x 2 k, tru o control von-100 k=100%) x 2 scenarios (normal, fee_stress) = 14 o danh gia. Day la stress thanh khoan nen khong chay exec-stress.
control: cap100_k100 (von 100, k=1.0 bypass volcap) normal phai khop published majority_1x (+165.17829563633% total_return 1.6517829563633004, -20.09% max_drawdown -0.20086073993367803, 63 trades) trong 1e-9 hoac STOP
volcap_formula: Voi tin hieu co limit L, direction d, duyet expiry bars idx=signal_index+1..signal_index+12 theo thu tu: cand=engine._entry_fill(bar,d,L); neu cand None -> bo (no-touch). Neu k>=1.0 -> fill ngay tai cand (control bypass, bit-identical engine). Neu k<1.0: notional=equity_hien_tai*leverage(1x); qty=notional/cand; cap=k*float(bar[volume_column]); neu qty<=cap -> fill tai cand; nguoc lai coi nhu unfilled o bar do (volcap_skip+1) va thu bar ke tiep trong expiry. Khong khop mot phan, khong doi gia entry. Quyet dinh chi dung bar hien tai + equity qua khu (causal), tru luu y: full-bar volume ve ly thuyet chi biet sau khi bar dong (intrabar look-ahead nhe, ap dung dong nhat). Day la logic verbatim tu scripts/opencode_r8n_volcap.py (import truc tiep, khong copy sua).
reuse_note: scripts/opencode_r9n_volscale.py TAI DUNG truc tiep ham run_volcap_backtest + TRADE_COLUMNS tu scripts/opencode_r8n_volcap.py (import, khong duplicate logic). Chi driver khac: vong lap theo von khoi diem (initial_equity theo branch) + cong thuc monthly dung ratio=final/initial (thay vi /100 co dinh) + assert ma tran 7-branch vonxk.
rng_scheme: Deterministic, khong co draw ngau nhien. seed_base=1729 chi ghi de dam bao sap xep/tai lap co dinh danh (signals sort by bar_index, candles sort by open_time). Moi branch chay lai tu dau voi cung thu tu (cong bang so sanh).
monthly_formula: ratio=final_equity/initial_equity_cua_branch; duration_years=(complete_evaluation_until - folds[0][0])/(365.2425*86400) theo parent_plan (giong v15/v30/v32); monthly_geometric_net=ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1; annual=ratio^(1/duration_years)-1. Khac v32 o cho mau so la initial cua branch (100/10k/1M), khong phai 100 co dinh.
engine_note: Phan con lai cua backtest (stop/timeout market-like o scenario fee, TP1 50% + TP2, funding long 0.0001/8h short 0, stop-first intrabar, TP suppression tren intrabar entry candle, drawdown trade-candle-close sampled, compounding tu equity hien tai, overlap next_available_index, holding validation, truncated-window reject) GIU NGUYEN nhu engine ohlc-v2 run_backtest via ham tai dung tu v32. Chi khoi entry-search co dieu kien volcap. k=1.0 bypass de lam control gate bit-identical.
verdict_note: Day la thang robustness theo von (do survival khi von tang + k giam), KHONG phai gate loi nhuan. k la gia dinh stress chu quan, khong suy ra tu microstructure/queue that. Khong claim maker fill probability tu OHLC. Von compounding theo equity: day chinh la thu can do. Drawdown trade-candle-close sampled. Stop/timeout market-like o scenario fee. Khong promote branch hay claim validation/live.
